messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-09-15] standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2: Team Boreal still owns search-indexer, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-02-28] handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer: Quick one: the indexer belongs to the Boreal team starting today. Thanks to Cinder for running it until now.
- [2025-08-13] standup/boreal/2025-08-13: The search indexer must stay on OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. Reminder that reporting depends on the ledger.
- [2025-12-15] handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction: The 2025-11-18 note about the indexer named the wrong team. The Dune team took it over on that date; the Ember team did not.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29-2: The Cinder team noticed that search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-11-18] handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer: Handover: as of today the indexer moves from Boreal to Ember. Marcus walked Oskar through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-03-03] standup/boreal/2025-03-03: Dependency map update: the search indexer needs the product catalog (product documents).
- [2025-11-07] standup/boreal/2025-11-07: We agreed today that search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. The reason is that incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.
- [2026-02-04] standup/boreal/2026-02-04: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation. Boreal saw that scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team. Cinder owns the indexer.
- [2025-10-27] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (the search indexer, 2025-10-24). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2026-03-16] standup/ember/2026-03-16: Oskar has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez. Ember noticed that search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for billing-api: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season). Observation from the Atlas team: after Tuesday's deploy, search-indexer's p99 latency doubled.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: Team Atlas saw that the billing service's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: Team Dune owns the reporting service.
- [2025-11-25] standup/cinder/2025-11-25: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-01-23] standup/ember/2026-01-23: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: Atlas owns billing-api. Atlas looks after the flags service.
- [2025-12-08] standup/dune/2025-12-08: Tomasz picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today. Team Dune saw that the ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-11-11] standup/boreal/2025-11-11: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for the Atlas team goes to Tomasz.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2025-07-16] standup/atlas/2025-07-16: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-04-10] standup/boreal/2025-04-10: Team Boreal saw that the catalog service's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: The event bus is a the Boreal team service. The Boreal team owns notifier.
- [2025-02-06] standup/atlas/2025-02-06: Billing-api calls the ledger service for invoice postings, so treat the ledger service as a hard dependency of billing-api.
- [2025-01-16] standup/cinder/2025-01-16: Diego Alvarez takes the first the Cinder team on-call shift of the year.
- [2026-01-14] standup/dune/2026-01-14: Reminder: Tomasz is on call for team Dune this cycle.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: Marcus is on call for the Boreal team to start the year.

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns the service search-indexer depends on?

message.reasoning:
The question: Who is on call for the team that owns the service search-indexer depends on?

Search-indexer depends on the product catalog (2025-03-03 entry). The product catalog lives with the Cinder team (2025-01-17).

Who is on call for Cinder team? Let's look at entries mentioning Cinder on-call:
- 2025-11-25 standup/cinder: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- 2026-03-17 standup/cinder: Reminder: notifier owned by Cinder (not on-call).

The most recent on-call info for Cinder: 2025-11-25 Diego. There's also 2026-01-23 ember entry saying Diego carries the phone for Ember — but that's Ember team, not Cinder.

Any later Cinder on-call entry? 2026-03-17 is only about notifier. So the latest Cinder on-call info is Diego (2025-11-25). Also 2025-01-16 Diego Alvarez takes the first Cinder on-call shift of the year.

So answer: Diego.
